items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I'm telling you Armstrong, I hadn't seen Armstrong for so long until I thought, I'd not forget about him.

ctx.x: Do you remember little dad? Dad. The banjo player, he was just about deaf probably about that time. Little short, short fella. He's passed on, but he told me about you a couple of years ago. I'm sure I must know.

Because like I tell you, there was one you could name that I didn't know. Because like I tell you, if they could play or they didn't play, that was my friend. What did he say? We lived. We lived. I'm telling you Armstrong, I hadn't seen Armstrong for so long until I thought, I'd not forget about him. But I was looking in the showcase at the App Dallas and somebody told me, another white fellow was there looking at the showcase too. And so we talked, talked, talked, and first thing you know, was looking at, do you…
